fields.reasoning: The change set serves m2-interviews-recorded (decision fix-plan-dup-serves-interviews-recorded) and its other decisions (skip-recorded-answer-by-question, capture-records-picks-planner-records-proxies) are all about answer capture in session done and the planner guide.
